user.title: Connect Matter Reflex
user.description: Select the commissioned board. Home Assistant checks whether the Matter server can transfer rules.

fallback.title: Set up rules transfer over Thread
fallback.description: This Matter server cannot transfer the manufacturer’s rules. Enter the 64-character hexadecimal key provisioned over USB to authenticate the fallback channel. The lease uses the standard Matter command.

error.cannot_connect: Authentication failed. Check the USB-provisioned key and Thread IPv6 connectivity.
error.matter_unavailable: Cannot reach the node over Matter. Check its availability and retry.

abort.no_nodes: No commissioned Matter Reflex node found on the fabric.
